{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate by channel
# Conversion rate = converted / total
conversion_rates = filtered_df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).round(4)

# Pivot to make channel the columns
conversion_rates_pivot = conversion_rates.pivot_table(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='mean')

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
diff = conversion_rates_pivot['email'] - conversion_rates_pivot['paid_search']

# Print results
print("Conversion rates by segment and channel:")
print(conversion_rates_pivot)
print("\nDifference (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(diff)"}
